prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury lawyer in Houston for a car wreck?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” personal injury lawyer in Houston for every car wreck — the right attorney depends on your injuries, the facts of the crash, insurance limits, whether you want to try the case, and your personality/communication preferences. I can, however, help you find a top attorney who’s right for your situation. A quick way to proceed: tell me your ZIP code and a few facts about the crash (injuries, fault, any police report, and how long ago it happened) and I’ll prepare a short list of highly qualified lawyers near you.

Until then, here’s a practical guide to find and pick the best Houston car-wreck lawyer for your case.

What to look for
- Substantial experience with car-accident cases and auto-insurance claims (not just general practice).  
- Trial experience and a record of verdicts/large settlements for car-wreck victims.  
- Board certification (Texas Board of Legal Specialization) in Personal Injury Trial Law is a strong plus.  
- Resources: law firm must be able to hire accident reconstructionists, medical experts, etc., if needed.  
- Good client reviews and peer recognition (Super Lawyers, Best Lawyers, Martindale‑Hubbell AV ratings, Million Dollar Advocates, local trial lawyer associations).  
- Clear contingency-fee agreement (usually no recovery = no fee) and transparent costs.  
- Strong communication: timely responses and clear explanations.

Where to find reputable lawyers
- Referrals from friends/family or other attorneys.  
- Texas Bar Association or the Harris County Bar Association referral service.  
- Directories/ratings: Super Lawyers, Best Lawyers, Martindale‑Hubbell, Avvo, and the Texas Board of Legal Specialization.  
- Local trial lawyer groups like the Houston Trial Lawyers Association or Texas Trial Lawyers Association.

Questions to ask at a free consultation
- How many car-accident cases have you handled? How many resulted in jury trials?  
- What’s your track record for settlements and verdicts in similar cases?  
- Who in the firm will handle my case day-to-day?  
- How do you charge (percentage, costs advanced, any other fees)?  
- What is your assessment of my case and likely timeframe?  
- Do you have the resources to take the case to trial if needed?

Practical things to do now
- Preserve evidence: photos of the scene, damage, injuries; medical records and bills; police report.  
- Don’t give recorded statements to the other driver’s insurer without consulting an attorney.  
- Be aware of Texas’s statute of limitations (usually two years from the crash for personal injury).

If you want, provide your ZIP code and a short summary of the crash and injuries and I’ll compile a targeted list of highly rated Houston personal injury lawyers who handle car wrecks and note their relevant experience and recent outcomes.
